description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running with real historical data. Your goal is to set up a workspace with two instrument-linked charts.

1. Open two new Daily charts for 'SPY'.
2. Add 'Bollinger Bands' (Period 20, StdDev 2) to the first chart.
3. Add 'RSI' (Period 14) to the second chart.
4. Link both windows using the same link color (e.g., Red or Blue) via the instrument link button in the chart toolbar.
5. Verify the link works by changing the instrument on one chart to 'AAPL'. The other chart should automatically switch to 'AAPL'.
6. Save the workspace via File > Save Workspace.

Expected Result: Two charts, both showing 'AAPL', both having the same active instrument link color.
